rule: Fixed list of 178 tasks: the 90 tasks of ab-policy-rep90 (chosen 2026-11-18, unchanged) and 88 tasks added on 2026-11-23, 15 per domain, but 14 in operations and 14 in support, where no more candidates have evidence A or B. It is not drawn again. Pool: public AutomationBench tasks that no upstream issue or pull request names, that have none of our defect labels, and that our adapter can run. Policy task, first 90: the prompt names a policy and the task has at least one must-not check. Policy task, added tasks: the task has at least one must-not check (a negative check, or a check that already holds at the start); rule_source says where its rule is. Evidence for the checks, from all graded runs of the harness: A = the task was passed in full at least once; B = never passed in full, and every check passed in at least one run. Tiers by the Haiku 5.5 baseline (at least 3 runs): easy (pass rate 67% or more), medium (20% to 67%), near miss (under 20%, mean partial 0.6 or more), far (the rest). Added tasks: per domain the tiers follow the shares of all policy tasks of the pool that have a tier (4 easy, 4 medium, 2 near miss, 5 far), a tier with too few tasks filled from the next one; A tasks first, B tasks only where a domain has fewer than 15 A tasks (marketing 2, support 2); the choice inside a tier was random (seed 20261123). 144 candidates had no graded run. A Haiku 5.5 baseline run on them (3 trials) was stopped after the finance and HR tasks, so 12 added tasks of these two domains had their first run on 2026-11-23; such a task has evidence A only when Haiku passed it, so it is an easy or medium task. In the other four domains the added tasks come only from tasks that were run before. A full pass shows that all checks can be met together; it does not show that a check rejects a wrong result. The first 90 are a tuning set. The added tasks were run, and no method was tuned on them: report the first 90 and the added tasks next to the whole set.

fields.evidence: A or B, see the rule
fields.type: primary policy type, as in select_policy_types.py
fields.runs: our graded runs of the task (any model, any profile)
fields.part: first90 (ab-policy-rep90, values as recorded on 2026-11-18) or added (2026-11-23)
fields.rule_source: where the rule of the task is: prompt names a policy (first rule, not scanned); rule records in the data, conditions in the request only, no rule found (data scan of 2026-11-23, one run of one model)
fields.first_run_2026_11_23: added tasks only: the task had no graded run before the Haiku baseline run of this date

flagged.about: tasks whose checks are in doubt. defect_label: we found a wrong check (left out). check_never_passed: policy tasks of the pool with a check that failed in every graded run (left out). in_set_with_evidence_b: in this set with the weaker evidence B (first 90: as recorded on 2026-11-18). found_after_selection: tasks of the first 90 where the failure analysis of 2026-11-22 found a wrong check; they stay in the set and are marked in every report.
